deadline.value: The graduate school lists January as the typical PhD deadline without a date; SEES only dates the international master's deadline (January 14, 2027), so apply by early January.

also.quote: The deadline for all VISA Masters applications is January 14, 2027.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Contact a potential supervisor before applying and name at least one in your application, or it will not be reviewed.
supervisor.quote: SEES asks that you attempt to contact a potential supervisor directly and PRIOR to submitting your online application | Please make sure to list at least one potential supervisor on your application or the application will not be reviewed.

funding.value: All full-time PhD students without outside funding get four years of university support plus an RA or TA.
funding.quote: All full-time graduate students admitted to the School of Earth, Environment & Society, without any external funding or scholarships, receive basic financial support from the University for two years (M.A./M.Sc.) or four years (Ph.D.).

entry_route.value: Usually after a master's, but direct entry to the PhD from an undergraduate degree is available for qualified students.
entry_route.quote: A direct entry to the Ph.D. program from the undergraduate degree for students with the appropriate requirements is also available.
